mainEntity.name: When do I actually need a new bathtub installed instead of a repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tub installation is a good fit if your existing tub is cracked, stained, leaking, hard to clean, or no longer safe to use. It is also practical if you want a faster update than a full bathroom remodel. If you are dealing with water damage, soft flooring, or repeated leaks, the project should start with a repair assessment before a new tub goes in.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose replacement when the tub is cracked, leaking, stained, or unsafe. If there is water damage or soft flooring, have the area inspected before installing a new tub.
